faq_heading: Tsawwassen golf course homes: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Tsawwassen golf course home cost?
faq.a: The 87 golf course houses that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $1,525,000, with the middle half between $1,345,000 and $1,849,950. All Tsawwassen detached houses had a median of $1,507,500.

faq.q: What counts as a golf course home in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: In Paragon the agent who lists the house picks Golf Course Nearby or Golf Course Dev. under Site Influences, so Tsawwassen homes beside a fairway and homes a short walk away can both appear.

faq.q: How fast do Tsawwassen golf course homes sell?
faq.a: 17 days at a median, closing at 97.2% of list, with 3% over the list price. All Tsawwassen houses took 22 days.

faq.q: Which Tsawwassen neighbourhoods have the most golf course homes?
faq.a: Pebble Hill had 20 sales with the flag, Beach Grove 15 and Tsawwassen Central 14 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

Use this search to see Tsawwassen detached houses currently for sale where the listing flags a golf course on the street or nearby. The most golf course sales were in Pebble Hill (20), Beach Grove (15) and Tsawwassen Central (14).

Of 146 detached houses that closed in Tsawwassen between November 1 and August 31, 87 (60%) carried a golf course flag. They sold for a median of $1,525,000, 1% above the $1,507,500 median for every Tsawwassen house.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a Tsawwassen golf course home

items.t: Establish how far the house is from the course and whether the back or the side faces it. The flag showed up on 87 Tsawwassen sales, so it covers a wide range of lots. Pebble Hill had the most flagged sales (20).

Examine the windows, siding and fence on the course side for ball marks, and ask the seller whether there was damage, a claim or netting. The typical house was built in 1980, which tells you how old the roof and windows facing the course may be.

Get a title search to see whether a right-of-way, covenant or building setback is registered against the lot. The typical lot was 7,077 square feet, so the course side is often a large share of the yard.
View the house early in the morning and again in the evening, since course maintenance and play change the noise. They took 17 days to sell at a median, which leaves room for a second visit.
Line the price up against nearby houses with no flag. The medians were $1,525,000 with it and $1,507,500 without, and floor area and age explain part of that.
